title: Tiered Pricing for Stay-Home Notice Dedicated Facilities to Ensure Affordability
what_it_is: Tiered Pricing for Stay-Home Notice Dedicated Facilities to Ensure Affordability

sections.label: Travellers served by system
sections.summary: The system has served about 190,000 travellers since its formation.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: The system has served about 190,000 travellers since its formation.

sections.label: Standard SDF fee and appeals
sections.summary: A standard fee is charged regardless of assigned SDF, and appeals are considered case-by-case based on travellers' financial or personal circumstances.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: As travellers cannot choose their SDF and the cost structure is largely similar, a standard fee is charged regardless of the SDF that they are assigned to.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: For instance, those who require elderly or disability-friendly facilities, or those travelling with children or minors may require specific room arrangements.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: We consider appeals on a case-by-case basis, based on the travellers’ financial or personal circumstances.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: We understand that travellers would like to have more choice and flexibility for their SDFs.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: We are constantly reviewing our system and studying ways to provide travellers more options to meet their preferences and budgets, without compromising the safety of travellers, operational staff and importantly, the community.

sections.label: SDF tiers and case-by-case review
sections.summary: Different tiers of SDFs exist for different archetypes of travellers, and cases will be looked at case-by-case while refining the system.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: But we understand the points that the Member has raised, especially when the Member has talked about foreign domestic workers, different circumstances.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: We will look at those cases on a case-by-case basis, in addition to the present arrangement of having different tiers of SDFs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: There is an economy tier catered to many of the profiles or archetypes that the Member talked about – workers from the construction, marine process industries as well as foreign domestic workers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: So, we do have different tiers of SDFs for different archetypes of travellers coming in.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: At the same time, like I have said, we will look at those issues on a case-by-case basis, and we will continue to refine the system to cater for various flexibilities, without compromising the operational safety of our operational staff and our community
